items.claim: Translucent token's alpha dropped when the swatch picks a color
Runs never form under the default `namePrefix: ''` or `'wzl-'`, because the name kept its `--` while the group lost it
items.note: Names now drop their `--` everywhere they are drawn, so a lone row with no prefix now reads `gap`, not `--gap`.

items.claim: Scale's Reset pushes the name to a second grid row
items.note: The new `TokenPanel.browser.test.tsx` did run here: it fails before the fix and passes after.

items.claim: `factors` scale with base 0 writes an Infinity factor when a step is dragged; a negative base writes a negative one
Dragging a step with no entry in `factors` does nothing, and base 0 gives Infinity
items.note: duplicate of the previous finding, fixed 423be585ac. I made a behavior call here and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`: a dragged step that no factor can reach now overrides the step through `onChange`. Refitting to factors from a negative base now gives factors of 1, as a zero base already did.

items.claim: Refitting to `ratio` with a non-positive last step gives NaN or 0
Sorting tokens into sections copies the section on every token, which is quadratic
items.note: There is no test that fails before: a cost like this can't be asserted deterministically in a unit test.

items.claim: `refitScale` rounds to 2 places, so switching rule moves the steps; dragging uses 3 places
items.note: Both now round to the 4 places the number fields show. Two existing expectations changed: 1.34 → 1.3416 and 1.583 → 1.5833.

items.claim: A run row named exactly as its group draws a blank name when it is not the first row
`inferTokenType` reads an upper-case duration as a string
`isShadow` accepts `inset` only as the first keyword
